# Uebermensch Vault

This directory is your personal profile/vault. Open it in Obsidian.

Four canonical roots organised around your relationship with CoS (your Chief
of Staff). See `vault/specs/profile.md` for the full layout.

- `directives/` — **standing orders for CoS**
  Config + research framing CoS reads. `profile.md`, `topics.md`, `sources.md`,
  `theses/`, `personas/`, `me.md`, `projects.md`, `avoid.md`, `research/`,
  `prompts/` (one-shot research questions).

- `input/` — **material for me to read** (CoS-curated; gitignored)
  `raw/` (driver-fetched URL summaries), `wiki/` (LLM-maintained knowledge
  graph), `briefs/` (daily + deepdive), `reports/` (weekly + per-prompt).

- `output/` — **my own writing** (CoS reviews + suggests)
  Drafts, memos, position papers — organise as you like.

- `action/` — **things awaiting my greenlight**
  `strategies/` (active positioning), `plans/` (execution plans),
  `events/` (calendar; `events/generated/` is driver-pulled and gitignored),
  `tasks/` (executive-level todos).
